svg.title: Back of the envelope math
svg.desc: The photo app estimate is built line by line. Uploads: 10 million times 1 divided by 100,000 seconds is 100 a second. Views: 5,000 a second. Storage: 5 TB a day, about 2 PB a year. Bandwidth: 1 GB a second. Then each line gets its verdict: a few servers, a CDN, object storage, a CDN.
svg.text: Size for the peak, 2 to 10 times the average. Add room for backups and copies.
Round numbers, one multiply, one divide. The big results pick the design.
